name: export-license-error
description: The export endpoint answers 402 Payment Required with a JSON error body, which is what exportAssetsJSON renders when exportValidateLicense fails -- an expired or invalid license, the easiest failure to overlook because it is neither 401 nor 5xx. get_json must surface it as an error and the run must stop there. The point of the scenario is the second assertion: a failed source read must not turn into a POST. Uploading an empty or partial batch here would silently truncate the receiver's view of the estate while every run still reported success. 402 is also outside get_json's retry set (408/425/429/500/502/503/504), so exactly one request is made -- request_count pins that, and would catch a retry storm against an endpoint that will never relent.
